svg.title: Where does the book really change?
svg.text: Where does the book really change?
Optimal cuts of the 94 sides into contiguous blocks, with no borders assumed.
Segments we assumed (opening · heartland · 26–28 · diamonds · end)
Borders found by the data alone (5 blocks, letters + trigrams)
Variance of the side profiles explained by k blocks — book order vs shuffled order
Gains stop after 5 blocks. Stable borders: 12b|13a (every feature set), 40b|41a, 33a|33b, 25a|25b.
The opening 2–5 is not a block of its own; the U register begins at table 41, not 44; a new break at 12|13
(T and X rise, U appears). Dialect chain and U register both hold on the new parts.
